messages:
support-ops: @here BrightFrame reporting embeddings vectors/sec dropped ~3x starting 22:39 UTC. Tokens/sec looks normal. They also saw intermittent 401s followed by client retries and billing spikes. Pasting quick timeline and sample logs below.

oliver: can you paste a short repro and the logs you have? any recent rollouts?

support-ops: logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-12T22:38:52Z INFO incoming req id=abc123 client=brightframe team=brightframe path=/v1/embeddings
2026-03-12T22:38:57Z WARN auth failed key=bf-team-old status=401 id=abc124
2026-03-12T22:38:57Z INFO retry queued id=abc124 attempt=1
2026-03-12T22:38:59Z WARN auth failed key=bf-team-old status=401 id=abc125
2026-03-12T22:39:02Z INFO batch queued size=128 node=gpu-12 queue_depth=47
2026-03-12T22:39:03Z ERROR gpu_slot_wait overflow wait_ms=812 id=batch-876
2026-03-12T22:39:10Z INFO request served id=abc126 tokens=64 vectors=512 time_ms=2300
```

mike: looks like a key rotation event around 22:38. deploy-bot reported a rotation for brightframe keys in the gateway. That timing matches.

eng-gateway-bot: Key rotation completed for team=brightframe at 2026-03-12T22:38:56Z (rotation-id=rot-20260312-01) :rotating_light: 

sara: hypothesis: intermittent 401s from clients that haven't refreshed keys -> client-side immediate retries with high concurrency -> sudden burst of requests into embeddings path -> batcher window grows (bigger batches) and queue_depth spikes -> GPUs saturate waiting on slots -> vectors/sec drops because vectorization latency per-batch jumps. Token accounting still looks ok because tokens/sec is measured post-tokenizer and some token requests are cached/shorter.

oliver: agree. Also saw 429s downstream in the logs right after the 401 bursts. Clients retrying without backoff will amplify.

support-ops: repro steps we used in staging (minimal, run from laptop or k8s job):
```
# naive repro: 200 concurrent workers sending embeddings, flip auth header for 10% of requests
for i in $(seq 1 200); do
  (while true; do
    KEY=$([ $((RANDOM%10)) -eq 0 ] && echo "old-key" || echo "new-key");
    curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
      -d '{"model":"embed-lite","input":"ok"}' >/dev/null &
    sleep 0.02
  done) &
done
wait
```
And a small Python harness that toggles key validity to simulate rotation + clients that do immediate retries (no jitter).

mike: when we ran that in staging with 200 concurrency we saw queue_depth jump from ~5 to ~60, batch sizes increased to 128, mean vectors/sec per-GPU dropped from ~120k to ~35k, GPU wait_ms spiked to 600-900ms.

sara: suggested quick mitigations: 1) Gateway should return 401 with Retry-After? or ideally 403/422? but better is 429 with Retry-After when rotation in-progress so clients back off instead of hammering. 2) Add a short auth-grace window during rotations (accept previous key for 30s) and emit a deprecation header. 3) Add client-side recommended backoff + jitter in our SDKs. 4) Reduce max batch window temporarily when queue_depth > threshold to protect latency.

oliver: also propose a short-term firewall rule: apply request-smoothing for brightframe team IPs (cap concurrency per IP range) until clients adopt SDK patch.

support-ops: customer-success notified BrightFrame and recommended SDK patch + staggered rotation. They replied asking for timeline and impact numbers.

customer-success: shared numbers with customer: peak vectors/sec drop 3x, estimated 2.8x increase in tail latency during the incident, and a few cents extra billing due to retry amplification. Customer asked for RCA and remediation plan.

mike: long-term: batching manager should consider auth-failure-aware heuristics: if N auth failures observed in short window, prefer smaller batch windows and enable stricter per-client rate limits. Also add metrics: auth_fail_rate, post_auth_retry_multiplier to show amplification.

support-ops: next steps assigned: 
- oliver: run controlled staging run with rotation and capture full flamegraphs (ETA 4h)
- sara: open gateway PR to accept previous key for 30s + add deprecation header (ETA 1d)
- mike: add queue_depth -> batch_window circuit to runtime (ETA 3d)
- support-ops: draft RCA for BrightFrame and schedule customer call (ETA 24h) :white_check_mark:

oliver: I'll post the staging replay artifacts here when done.

support-ops: thanks all. tagging for follow-up :eyes:
